Name: Dave Portrait Mod
Author: BnBUO
Description:
SMAPI and Content Patcher are required to run this mod.
Replaces Vincent's portraits with images of Dave Strider from Homestuck by Andrew Hussie (The Sprites Use Elements from Elliot's Spritesheet and the Portraits Drawn by NatBot [Me]).
This is my very first mod, and my first time doing sprite work. It seems to run fine on my computer, but since I am so new to this I am happy to try to figure out any issues or critiques of the mod/spritework.
